caption: The drawing depicts a stylized, gray horse in mid-leap, positioned horizontally across the page from left to right. The horse has a flowing mane and tail, both rendered with lines to indicate movement. Its body is outlined and shaded in a solid gradient, with minimal details for muscles and joints. Below the horse is a jump made of four horizontal bars set in a rectangular frame; the lines are steady and geometric. To the left of the jump, faint dotted lines suggest an alternate or previous position of the jump. The overall color of the drawing is monochromatic, using shades of gray pencil on a light beige or off-white background. A thin border frames the composition, and there is a small scale in the lower right corner labeled with the word “inches.”
title: Horse Weather Vane
